height: calc(100% - 6px); text-align: center; background-color: #22a50d; color: #ffffff; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; font-family: sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px;" class="md-btn  md-btn-raised" id="B-HXB_5a1c0011-0000bb01">START</BUTTON></foreignObject></g><g xml:space="preserve" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0)" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0)" type="svg-ext-html_button" id="HXB_5a1c0002-0000aa02"><rect id="svg_HXB_5a1c0012-0000bb02" height="80" width="190" y="175" x="290" stroke-width="0"/><foreignObject id="H-HXB_5a1c0012-0000bb02" width="190" height="80" y="175" x="290"><BUTTON style="width: calc(100% - 6px); height: calc(100% - 6px); text-align: center; background-color: #e75c5c; color: #ffffff; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; font-family: sans-serif; border-radius: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px;" class="md-btn  md-btn-raised" id="B-HXB_5a1c0012-0000bb02">STOP</BUTTON></foreignObject></g><g xml:space="preserve" font-family="sans-serif" stroke="#000000" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" y="215" x="640" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" id="GSE_5a1c0003-0000aa03"><ellipse xml:space="preserve" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" fill="#FFFFFF" ry="42" rx="42" cy="215" cx="640" id="GSE_5a1c0004-0000aa04"/></g><text x="640" y="285" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#22a50d" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">Green = running</text><text x="640" y="305" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#e75c5c" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">Red = stopped</text><text x="70" y="300" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="normal" fill="#444444" stroke="none" text-anchor="start">Press START to run the motor, STOP to switch it off.</text><text x="70" y="322" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="normal" fill="#444444" stroke="none" text-anchor="start">The lamp shows the real PLC output (MotorOut), not the button.</text><text x="400" y="405" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="normal" fill="#888888" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">Data source: OpenPLC runtime via Modbus TCP (openplc:502)</text><text x="400" y="425" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="normal" fill="#888888" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">Tags: StartPB (coil 0, write) / MotorOut (coil 1, read)</text></g></svg>
